g.text: Initialize all data inputs (PV, VAL_ZERO, SLOW, FAST, VAL_FULL) - without this, e.g. VAL_FULL is never read until FULL is fired once, breaking the UP_FAST/UP_SLOW clamp against it – Event
Increase OUT by SLOW, clamped to VAL_FULL – Event
Increase OUT by FAST, clamped to VAL_FULL – Event
Decrease OUT by SLOW, clamped to VAL_ZERO – Event
Decrease OUT by FAST, clamped to VAL_ZERO – Event
BOOL – TRUE if OUT is at or below VAL_ZERO (lower limit reached)
BOOL – TRUE if OUT is at or above VAL_FULL (upper limit reached)
